key_catalyst: IBM's enterprise capex shift warning sparking broad selloff in QQQ-heavy software stocks as investors reprice traditional software growth models
reasoning: IBM's enterprise capex shift warning has triggered a novel structural selloff in QQQ-heavy software names (ServiceNow -5%, Adobe -4.3%, Salesforce -2.2%), and this contagion is still spreading as investors reassess growth models overnight. Compounding this, Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish testimony pushing September hike odds to 63% is new information that hasn't been fully absorbed, while U.S.-Iran tensions are re-escalating with a reimposed naval blockade and fresh strikes keeping oil elevated—all three risks are unresolved and overlapping into the next session.
